$comment: BeatDrop montages BD3/BD4 (D415, plan docs/plan/2026-11-21-beatdrop-montages.md): the beat-locked edit planner (services/clip/beatdrop.py) and its effects (services/clip/beatdrop_fx.py). Engine numbers only; game numbers (which moments anchor a piece, how long before and after) are in data/games/<game>/beatdrop.json. Target numbers come from the chosen reel style (RS1) when one is set; else from `targets` here. Status proposed: synthetic fixtures only, real footage UNVERIFIED.

targets.source: defaults from the five BeatDrop references (plan 1.3): median shot 0.12-0.67 s, 53-116 cuts/min, 44-82 % of cuts on a music onset

coldOpen.$comment: minSec is a soft target: an earlier first drop wins and the cold open is shortened (logged); below minBars bars no intro fits and the plan records firstDropMissed (D415 review)

titles.$comment: BD5 (D416): the intro title, the in-scene pin, the outro hero and the credits (services/clip/beatdrop_titles.py). Each is a registry core function with presets (registry/functions/<fn>.json); the look (colours, fonts) comes from data/games/<game>/beatdrop.json `look`. Text: the brand and player name from data/profile.local.json at run time (never committed), the song title and the credit from the music record (the exact D414 credit text). `mode` pin: the title is tracked onto a flat area of the shot (OpenCV, CPU, bounded frames) and falls back to screen space when tracking is unsure (logged).

flash.$comment: a cut whose relative luminance jumps by cutDelta or more (darker side below darkerBelow; WCAG 2.3.1 numbers, services/overlay-server/flash-detect.mjs) counts in the same 3/s budget as the impact flash; over budget it gets a softenFrames luma-matched dissolve. The rendered file is measured with tools/fx-test.mjs analyseVideo at `sample`; above maxPerSec the render is failed, never published (D415 review)
